original_disassembly_research.method: context.py's linear Capstone pass reaches inline jump-table data at 0x067C and stops. The function-table jump_tables record supplies 56 two-byte entries; each target was decoded recursively with conditional target/fallthrough traversal until returns or direct transfers. No original byte arrays or capsules were saved.
original_disassembly_research.decode_note: At 0x06FA Capstone in CS_MODE_16 prints `cdq`; the instruction length is one byte, so opcode 99 has default 16-bit operand size (CWD: sign-extend AX into DX), matching the signed 32-bit threshold comparison.

candidate_disassembly_research.tool: pinned MSC 6.00AX profile msc600ax with /AL /Os /Oe /Og /Zi; registered C module only
candidate_disassembly_research.method: The candidate OMF object was decoded from its LessonDone public; traversal begins at function entry and all 56 embedded switch table targets. The candidate has 20 reachable conditional instructions. Its in-function _MapA relocation is the disp16 of ES:[BX+disp16], while CONST offset 0x0032 holds the segment relocation; the symbol table places MapA at 3E1D:0180.
candidate_disassembly_research.mapa_calculation: Both original and candidate use 16-bit BX shift-left-six and 16-bit addition of MeLocY, with the MapA base offset added by the effective-address calculation. For all 16-bit MeLocX/MeLocY bit patterns, both compute EA=(0x0180+((64*MeLocX+MeLocY) mod 65536)) mod 65536. The source-level out-of-bounds concern does not create a candidate-vs-original target-machine divergence.

MacTickCount aliases f_00F8_02BE and returns DX:AX; win_IsWinInFront aliases f_22BF_0A22 and receives AX; SetAlarmDropState uses vector 0x281C to S22 target and receives two caller-popped stack words. Short-circuit gates and case-30 call-before-read ordering are mapped.

Original and candidate MapA accesses have matching target 16-bit offset arithmetic for all coordinate words, not just caller-valid values: shift X by six in BX, add Y in BX, add MapA's 0x0180 offset in the memory effective address. Candidate OMF disp16 relocation targets _MapA, pinned at 3E1D:0180. Point field offsets and modeLevels/array element offsets are also mapped. All direct global reads and the two direct fd_50F6_1074 writes are listed under memory_state.
LessonDone directly writes only fd_50F6_1074 in case 54; case 30's only call-induced effects pass through the original SetAlarmDropState overlay body. Returns and call order are covered.

No pointer arguments cross LessonDone's external call boundaries. f_22BF_0A22 is a fastcall alias of win_IsWinInFront; f_00F8_02BE is MacTickCount; SetAlarmDropState is an original RTLink overlay call. Registered helper certificates describe modeled host sinks reached beneath SetAlarmDropState.
Registered source/evidence pins match their manifest SHA-256 values; the run, suite, negative control, ABI probe, alias audit, function table, symbol table and oracle identity are pinned in inputs.

remaining_differences.explanation: The registered C rebuild is 727 bytes (original 723; 527 differing positions; relocation count 9 vs 9), so historical byte/extent exactness remains open. The semantic CFG, predicates, calls, state reads/writes and value widths map completely. The original has a 56-entry table embedded at 0x067C-0x06EB and shared target blocks; linear instruction alignment misreads table words as instructions (diag decode_complete=false), so its residual labels are not semantic evidence. The surviving difference is source-to-machine lowering/layout debt, not an algorithm difference; this receipt does not claim byte identity.

review_notes: Case 13 has no bounds check in either implementation. Abstract-C out-of-bounds indexing is undefined, but the registered MSC 6.00AX candidate object computes the same 16-bit target effective address as the original for every 16-bit coordinate pattern; no caller-valid coordinate restriction is used for the target-machine equivalence conclusion.
The 16-bit C int and signed-long comparison conclusions rely on the pinned DOS ABI/compiler profile. They do not transfer to a modern 32-bit-int C compiler without explicit width types.

The strict module diagnostic reports 727 vs 723 bytes and is intentionally kept separate from behavioral status. It linearly decodes through inline switch data, so the 15 alignment residuals are not individually classified here.
Original source identity is the registered module.c; no comments were treated as proof. Original executable was read only for disassembly and identity hashing; no raw byte arrays/capsules were saved.

root_review.basis: Reviewed the whole-function branch/call/state/width maps, source/evidence identities, explanations of residue and differential/negative limits. Matching observed service boundaries are composed through the actual caller ABI and same callee/slot/state; finite coverage alone is not acceptance.
